title: TP READ fixture v1
description: TP READ data-plane fixture contract (CL-T0a). Covers exactly the three TP surfaces the loop reads: athlete calendar, workouts, comments. Comments are DERIVED FORM ONLY -- raw athlete comment text must never appear in a fixture. See docs/COACHING_LOOP_SPEC.md, 'Comment privacy (sol r2 f10)'.

athlete_id.description: Normalized int athlete id. Fixture-bundle-level exclusion checks run over this field before anything else in the bundle is read.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp the fixture was captured (or, for synthetic fixtures, authored).

source.description: Provenance marker. Synthetic fixtures ship in this repo; real_capture fixtures are dropped in later via the capture recipe (see coaching_loop/fixtures/README.md) and validated against this same schema.

calendar.description: The athlete-tz week the fixture covers.

week_start.description: Athlete-tz ISO Monday for the fetched week.

workout_ids.description: Foreign keys into `workouts[].workout_id`. May be empty (rest day).

sport.description: TP sport tag as captured, e.g. 'bike', 'strength', 'run', 'swim'. v1.0 loop-owned sports are bike + strength only; other sports may still appear in a real athlete's calendar and must round-trip through the fixture even though the loop does not touch them.

slot.description: Loop slot classification, when known. Null for workouts the loop does not classify (e.g. non-loop-owned sports).

structure.description: Opaque structured-workout payload as TP returns it (intervals, targets, etc). Left schema-open -- CL-T2a owns interpreting it.

loop_owned.description: Whether this workout_id is registered in engine_state.ownership_registry. Used by the op-grammar preflight (v1.1+) and by A1/A2 windowing, which only consider loop-owned sessions.

comments.description: Comments in DERIVED FORM ONLY. Raw comment text is never present here -- it may exist only transiently inside the fetch step and must not persist into a fixture, snapshot, or any other artifact. The one sanctioned exception to 'derived form only' anywhere in the loop is an at-most-8-word excerpt stored in an ExceptionRecord's ledger entry (see spec) -- fixtures never carry that either.

hits.description: Lexicon term ids the comment matched. Empty array = no hits, comment carried no A3-relevant signal.

length.description: Character length of the original raw comment (metadata only; never the text itself).
